treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Canada and the Government of the Italian Republic for the Avoidance of Double Taxation with respect to Taxes on Income and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion (2002)
eif_quote: SI/2012-16: Proclamation Giving Notice that the Convention between the Government of Canada and the Government of the Italian Republic for the Avoidance of Double Taxation with Respect to Taxes on Income and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion Came into Force on November 25, 2011 | Art. 28(2)(a)(i) (Finance Canada text): "in respect of tax withheld at the source on amounts paid or credited to non-residents, on or after the first day of January in the calendar year in which the exchange of instruments of ratification takes place; and"
source_title: Finance Canada: Canada-Italy Income Tax Convention 2002 (canada.ca, read via WebFetch; canada.ca not reachable by curl)

rates.quote: (a) except in the case of dividends paid by a non-resident-owned investment corporation that is a resident of Canada, 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company that controls directly or indirectly at least 10 per cent of the voting power in the company paying the dividends; and
(b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends, in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
(b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties in all other cases.

ppt.basis: none (no general PPT in treaty; MLI not applicable)
ppt.quote: Italy has signed but not ratified the MLI (map.json); the 2002 Convention contains no general principal-purpose test.

notes: 5% tier threshold is 10% of the VOTING POWER, recorded as ownership_threshold; excluded for Canadian NRO investment corporations. Not MLI-covered (Italy has not ratified). Royalty tier not modelled: Art. 12(2)(a) 5% "in respect of payments for the use of, or the right to use, computer software or any patent or for information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience (but not including any such royalties provided in connection with a rental or franchise agreement)"; Art. 12(3) copyright royalties (excl. software, film/TV) taxable only in residence State. Art. 11(3): interest exempt where paid by a State/subdivision, paid to the other State/its wholly-owned institutions, or on loans by institutions agreed by competent authorities. Exchange of instruments of ratification in 2011, so WHT effect 2011-01-01 (Canada); Italy: taxable periods beginning on or after 1 January 2011. Replaced the 1977 Convention (as amended 1989).
